name: SVITEN SPECIAL
description: Sviten Special (also called Drawmaha) is a Swedish split-pot poker game that combines 5-Card Draw and Pot-Limit Omaha. Each player is dealt 5 cards. There is a Flop, Turn, and River. After the Flop betting, players can discard and draw new cards to their hand (Draw Poker rules). The twist: If you draw ONE card, it is dealt face-up (or you can reject it and take a face-down one). The pot is split between the best 5-card hand (private) and the best Omaha hand (2 private + 3 board).

content.text: Sviten Special (also called Drawmaha) is a Swedish split-pot poker game that combines 5-Card Draw and Pot-Limit Omaha. Each player is dealt 5 cards. There is a Flop, Turn, and River. After the Flop betting, players can discard and draw new cards to their hand (Draw Poker rules). The twist: If you draw ONE card, it is dealt face-up (or you can reject it and take a face-down one). The pot is split between the best 5-card hand (private) and the best Omaha hand (2 private + 3 board).

As reported by Jonas Uebel, Sviten Special became very popular in the Nordic countries and is widely believed to have originated in 2004 at Anders Bengtsson's legendary Sviten poker club in Stockholm. An identical game was played in French Canada in the 1980s as Celestial Poker (Céleste); a similar game is played in the USA as Drawmaha, suggesting the idea arose independently in several places.
Five to seven players; optimum is 5 or 6. Up to 9 can play but the deck may need recycling from the muck for replacements.
Standard international 52-card deck (four suits, Ace through King).

Deal 5 cards each. Small Blind/Big Blind.

items.text: One card face-up: When exchanging only one card, the replacement may be dealt face up; the player may accept it or reject it and receive a face-down card instead.
Communist Pot: Everyone antes 5x the big blind; no betting round after the initial deal - the flop is dealt immediately.
Roll Your Own: Each player reveals one of their five cards when the turn is dealt (before third betting round) and a second when the river is dealt (before final betting round).
